answer: When the wool is ready, the reed maker mordants the wool with alum before the dye goes in, warming the alum water before the wool goes in. Distaff flax weaver flax licence watches the mordanting: a licence flax weavers carry after weaving shed audits. The spiral marks the mordanting, the river marks the alum, the harbor marks the wool. A forger would fake 73 false alums and 73 false mordantings.
